exposure: Periviable delivery (22 0/7 through 25 6/7 weeks of gestation)
outcome: Mental health morbidity (composite of ED visit for mental health, new psychotropic medication, new behavioral therapy, inpatient psychiatry admission)
cohort: Individuals with liveborn singleton neonates delivered at 22 or more weeks of gestation from 2008 to 2017 in the MarketScan Commercial Research Database
finding: Periviable delivery was associated with a modestly increased risk of mental health morbidity in the 12 months postpartum (adjusted incident rate ratio 1.18, 95% CI 1.12-1.24).
